question: Approve the ideation baseline — resolver design (A), per-probe restated AC-2, and the added 2-file documentation surface — and advance this task to implementation?

artifacts.summary: Ideation baseline for the two stale pi-subagents doctor probes. Approach: both probes resolve from the installed package's own package.json — the extension from pi.extensions, the intercom bridge from exports["./intercom-bridge"]. The probes currently test .ts sources that the package no longer ships, which is why a correctly installed pi-subagents reports two MISSING lines whose printed remedy cannot clear them. AC-2 is restated per-probe because pi-subagents declares the bridge only in exports, so one shared entry cannot drive both lines; the restatement is proposed, not pre-approved. Surface: 2 code files (internal/cli/pi.go, internal/cli/pi_frontdoor_test.go), net +60 to +90 LOC at +/-25 percent; plus a 2-file documentation surface (docs/runtime-support.md, docs/site/contributing/adding-a-runtime.md) carrying four one-line --extension path edits, which exceeds the seed's 2-file code estimate and is flagged for this gate. Primary proof owner is internal/cli/pi_frontdoor_test.go, reshaped to a manifest-driven fixture whose expected paths derive from the written package.json rather than a stat map naming the paths production checks. Deterministic Go tests only; no live lane needed. Note: the first prepared room was withdrawn before presentation because AC-1's bold identifier wrapped across two lines and the line-based --ac-scan reader could not see AC-1; that span is now joined and the scan returns AC-1, AC-2, AC-3. Design and AC content are unchanged from the authored baseline.
